leftEvidence.title: Passover near; delivery named; a plot forms

points.label: Action and sequence
points.left: Jesus names Passover and delivery for crucifixion while chief priests and elders gather and plan to seize him by deceit and kill him.
points.right: Jesus names Jerusalem, delivery, condemnation, Gentiles, mockery, scourging, crucifixion, and the third day in a compact forward sequence.

points.label: Evidence boundary
points.left: The passage materially bears on the Crucifixion while leaving part of its motive, mechanism, or later significance unstated.
points.right: The saying is detailed about actors and actions while recording no response from the Twelve in this range.

payload.posture: Jesus’ road prediction can be inspected beside the later Passover announcement and leaders’ plot.
payload.tension: The prediction names a future custody chain; the later scene places Jesus’ announcement beside a plan shaped by feast timing.
payload.title: Approach named / leaders gather
